user_saw: After any trusted-proxy settings change (including an upgrade that adds a required header), automations created through proxy sign-in were refused and auto-disabled with 'Restart recovery authentication owner changed'.
summary: Operator-source restore skips the exact shared-auth generation comparison for sources authenticated by the trusted proxy itself and relies on the saved grant check instead.
reasoning: The exact check `generationOwner.requiredGeneration !== snapshot.sharedGeneration` dates from 961f5c0b7099 (#166553), where it guarded short-lived Control UI restart recovery and the trusted-proxy generation already hashed proxy admission settings (ws-shared-generation.ts unchanged in substance since); refusing recovery there with 'start a new user turn' was a defensible conservative policy. d74a4aeb7d6 (#176422) made long-lived cron jobs retain operator sources and restore through the same restoreGatewayOperatorSource path, relying on authority surviving proxy-policy changes that the restore code never promised, so I classify it latent with that commit as trigger; a reader could also defend never-worked at d74a4aeb7d6.
